lesson.title: What Ganesha rides
lesson.carry: ganesha rides desire; it doesn't ride him
lesson.hook: Ganesha catches a giant mouse and rides it instead of killing it: desire steered, not destroyed

title: ride it, don't kill it
hook: a mouse the size of a mountain. he climbed on.
